web-guide-idea-115.audience: Followers interested in your particular everyday perspective.
web-guide-idea-115.offer: Choose the parts of your day that tell a story you want to share. A live diary works best with a recognisable theme, even when moments are ordinary.
web-guide-idea-115.steps.0: Pick a task or short window instead of filming everything.
web-guide-idea-115.steps.1: Explain what is happening for people arriving midway.
web-guide-idea-115.steps.2: End deliberately and keep private moments outside the stream.
web-guide-idea-115.equipment: A phone, stand or safe grip and reliable internet. Start with the equipment you already have.
web-guide-idea-115.returnReason: Consistency of voice and small evolving stories give people a reason to follow your next session.
web-guide-idea-115.promotion: Introduce the theme of your diary and what viewers can expect to see, without exposing private routines.

web-guide-idea-115.metadataDescription: Share selected everyday moments on your terms. Go live when you choose and keep private moments private. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
